items.prompt:
Energy can be
A) created from nothing
B) transferred or changed in form, but not created or destroyed
C) destroyed easily
D) made and unmade
items.answer: B) transferred or changed in form, but not created or destroyed

items.prompt:
The energy of motion is called
A) kinetic energy
B) potential energy
C) chemical energy
D) light energy

steps: Kinetic energy is energy of motion.

items.prompt:
A ball loses 20 J of potential energy and loses none to the air. It gains ____ of kinetic energy.
A) 20 J
B) 0 J
C) 40 J
D) 10 J

If one part of a system gains 15 J, the rest of the system lost
A) 15 J
B) 0 J
C) 30 J
D) 1.5 J

steps: The rest lost what the one part gained.

items.prompt:
A pendulum has the most kinetic energy
A) at the bottom
B) at the highest points
C) when still
D) never

steps: Fastest at the bottom means most kinetic energy.

items.prompt:
A hot block transfers 10 J to a cold block. The cold block gains
A) 10 J
B) 0 J
C) 20 J
D) 5 J

A pendulum's energy change from top to bottom is
A) potential energy changing into kinetic energy, with the total conserved
B) energy being destroyed
C) energy created from nothing
D) no change at all
items.answer: A) potential energy changing into kinetic energy, with the total conserved

steps: PE converts to KE, total conserved.

items.prompt:
The kinetic energy a falling ball gains equals the potential energy it loses because
A) energy is conserved, so lost energy becomes kinetic, not destroyed
B) energy is destroyed
C) energy doubles
D) energy is random
items.answer: A) energy is conserved, so lost energy becomes kinetic, not destroyed
